sections.title: Movers in Koreatown Who Plan Around Your Building
sections.content: Koreatown is one of the densest neighborhoods in the country, with apartment towers rising along Wilshire Boulevard and prewar apartment houses on blocks like Mariposa Avenue. Our apartment movers plan each job around your building's rules, the elevator and the curb before the crew heads out. Reasons to book SOS in Koreatown Building paperwork: When your property manager asks for a certificate of insurance, we prepare it ahead of move day so the crew isn't held up at the front desk. Licensed and insured: SOS Moving is CPUC licensed under CAL-T0192140, holds USDOT 3398018 and MC 1153871, and carries full liability coverage and workers' compensation. Public ratings: Customers rate us 4.9 on Google across 1,007 reviews. Looking for Ktown movers who handle the building side too? Send your address, floor and move date through our free estimate form, and we'll build the plan around them.

sections.title: Packing Services for Koreatown Apartments
sections.content: Our packers can box a whole Koreatown apartment or just the kitchen and fragile pieces, so everything is sealed and labeled before your elevator window opens. Add packing services when you book and the crew shows up ready to wrap and box. What the crew brings and does Wrap and tape: Moving blankets, shrink wrap and packing tape are included on every local move, and long-distance crews arrive with the supplies to protect your furniture too. Closets: Wardrobe boxes are part of that same included kit, so hanging clothes ride on a rod instead of getting folded into bags. TVs and furniture: We unmount TVs and take apart beds, desks and tables so they clear tower corridors and elevators, then put everything back together at the new place. Tell us which rooms you want packed and we'll size the crew and the time for it.

sections.title: Local Moving From Koreatown Across LA
sections.content: Our local crews move Koreatown households anywhere in Los Angeles by the hour, and our long-distance movers take over when the new address is out of state. The city draws Koreatown's official lines at Vermont Avenue, Western Avenue, Third Street and Olympic Boulevard, west of Downtown LA and south of Hollywood. Rates start from $119/hr for two movers and a truck Monday–Thursday at the cash rate, and $135/hr Friday–Sunday. What we plan for on Koreatown streets Wilshire bus lane: On weekdays during rush hours the Wilshire curb lane through Koreatown is reserved for buses, and cameras on Metro buses ticket vehicles parked in it, so we schedule the truck stop around those windows. Street parking: Parking is hard to find in Koreatown, especially in the evening, so we ask about your loading area, garage entrance or driveway when you book. Any building: Whether home is a tower by Wilshire/Vermont, where the Metro B and D lines meet, a unit near the D Line's Wilshire/Normandie or Wilshire/Western stations, or an older building off the boulevard, stairs, long carries and multiple stops stay in the hourly rate. Longer local routes can fall under CPUC Double Drive Time rules, while long-distance and out-of-state moves are priced through a free estimate.

sections.title: Long-Distance Moves Out of Koreatown
sections.content: When the next address is in another state or at the far end of California, our long-distance crews load at your Koreatown building and deliver to the new door, whether that's up the coast to the Bay Area, Portland or Seattle or inland to Las Vegas or Phoenix. Planning a move out of Koreatown Both buildings: If your Koreatown tower and your new building both ask for insurance certificates or elevator bookings, we line up the paperwork for each end before loading day. Storage gap: When move-out and move-in dates don't match, our storage service can hold your belongings until the new place is ready. Delicate pieces: Art, antiques and custom furniture can go with white glove handling, wrapped individually and set in place at the new home. Staying in Los Angeles after all? Our local moving crews bill by the hour, and long-distance estimates are free.

sections.title: Office Moves in Koreatown
sections.content: Moving an office, studio or storefront in Koreatown? Our commercial movers pack desks, files and equipment and work within your building's move rules.

faq.question: Can you move me into a Koreatown high-rise that asks for a certificate of insurance?
faq.answer: Yes. Send us your property manager's requirements when you book, and we'll prepare the certificate of insurance before move day and plan the job around your reserved elevator time. SOS Moving is CPUC licensed and carries full liability coverage and workers' compensation.

faq.question: Where does the moving truck park for a move on Wilshire Boulevard?
faq.answer: On weekdays during rush hours, the curb lane on Wilshire through Koreatown is reserved for buses, and Metro buses carry cameras that ticket vehicles parked in it. We plan the truck stop outside those windows, or around your building's loading area if it has one. Street parking in Koreatown is hard to find, especially in the evening, so share your building's access details when you book.

faq.question: What do movers in Koreatown, Los Angeles charge per hour?
faq.answer: Rates start from $119/hr for two movers and a truck Monday–Thursday at the cash rate, and $135/hr Friday–Sunday. Stairs, long carries and multiple stops are included; a $30 gas fee applies, and the $50 deposit goes toward your total cost. Pianos add $200, and items heavier than 300 lbs add $150.

faq.question: Can you do a same-day move in Koreatown?
faq.answer: Same-day moves are available based on crew availability. Call 909-443-0004, Monday – Sunday, 8AM – 6PM, and mention whether your building needs an elevator reservation or a certificate of insurance, since those can decide how soon we can start.

faq.question: Do you move people from Koreatown to other states?
faq.answer: Yes. Our long-distance service handles out-of-state and cross-country moves from Koreatown, and packing, storage and white glove handling can be added to the same move. Request a free estimate with both addresses and your move date.
